state.row: 8.12 if_revision, idempotency keys, batch-as-one-undo. Done when: a retry after a timeout does not duplicate. The user decided 8.12 shall have if_revision and asked that Jev and Laya review everything built.
state.design_decided: Token = SceneDocument.revision (absent = 0), bumped by one per stored write. MCP requires ifRevision on stored scenes.edit and scenes.delete (revisionRequired); the Editor command leaves it optional and checks it when present. The check runs in the Editor store write path under a cross-process file lock (gx_fs::FileLock over File::lock). Editor Save to origin refuses revisionMismatch when the stored scene moved on. Idempotency key: optional on the six Editor MCP writes, stripped before the strict parse, ledger in <store root>/.idempotency.json locked across lookup, execute and record; same key with other arguments refuses idempotencyKeyReused; refusals are not recorded.
tests_run: services/editor-mcp/tests/write_semantics_surface.rs (6, shipped binary): a retry after a lost reply through a new process returns the first answer and leaves one object; same key other arguments refused; stale and missing revision refused with nothing written; a 3-edit batch is one revision; four processes racing on revision 0 land exactly once; three processes retrying one key concurrently get one answer and one write; a keyed create retried is answered; every Editor write lists idempotencyKey and edit/delete list ifRevision.

gx-editor (4 new): batch is one revision, stale lands nothing, no-op answers the found revision, unconditional Editor write still bumps; a session target naming ifRevision is refused CommandUnknownField; Save over an agent edit is refused and the session still saves to a file; save moves the revision in session and base so undo/redo then save works; stale delete keeps the scene.

gx-write-semantics (5 new): key reuse refused without running; refusals not recorded; fingerprint ignores key order but not edit order; byte bound evicts oldest; a new LedgerFile instance replays; a damaged ledger refuses loudly.
gx-fs lock (2): four threads never overlap; released on drop.

lock_covers_read_check_write.instructions: In editor_stored_edit, is the lock held from before the read until after the write, so a stale batch cannot land?

criteria.false: No, a writer can slip between read and write.

stale_checked_before_apply.instructions: Is a stale ifRevision refused before any edit is applied or written?

save_refuses_overwrite.instructions: Does editor_save_origin refuse when the stored revision differs from the one the session read, and keep the session revision in step after a save?

retry_cannot_duplicate.instructions: Given mcp_command_tool and ledger_file_once, can a retry with the same key and arguments ever execute the write a second time while the ledger file is intact?

criteria.false: No, it replays the first answer.

key_reuse_safe.instructions: Is a reused key with different arguments refused rather than answered with the first result?

deadlock_risk.instructions: Can the ledger lock and the project scene lock deadlock (taken in opposite orders on two paths)?

criteria.false: No, every path takes ledger then scene, or scene alone.

weakest_point.instructions: Which is the weakest point of this implementation?

criteria.crash_window: A crash after the write and before the ledger save makes the retry refused revisionMismatch instead of replayed.
criteria.damaged_stored_revision: stored_revision treats an unreadable scene file as having no revision and lets the write through.
criteria.unbounded_lock_wait: FileLock waits without a bound, so a hung writer blocks others.
criteria.editor_delete_unguarded: The Editor's own delete still runs without ifRevision.

must_fix_before_acceptance.instructions: Is there a defect in this code that must be fixed before the row is accepted?

criteria.true: Yes, a defect must be fixed.
criteria.false: No defect blocks acceptance; the weak points are named limitations.
